faq.q: Where do Tsawwassen townhomes under $1.2M actually sit?
faq.a: On the page text read for this file, the feed's cards are labelled Tsawwassen North, Tsawwassen Central and Cliff Drive; on the developer's own material, Boardwalk in Tsawwassen North offers townhomes, and the live page also frames established complexes in Beach Grove.

faq.q: How does the Tsawwassen North leasehold work?
faq.a: At Boardwalk, the developer states homes are purchased with a 99-year leasehold, presented as costing significantly less than a comparable freehold property; the homes sit on Tsawwassen Lands, where Tsawwassen First Nation is self-governing with jurisdiction over land management, so the lease documents themselves — not a listing summary — are the source to rely on for prepaid status, ground rent and taxes.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Tsawwassen townhome?
faq.a: School District 37, address-based. Tsawwassen's elementaries include Cliff Drive (5025 12 Ave), Beach Grove (5955 17a Ave) and South Park (735 Gilchrist Dr), with South Delta Secondary (750 53 St) as the secondary school; for the sample address 1299 56 St the locator result is Cliff Drive Elementary and South Delta Secondary. Check the exact address in the SD37 School Locator.
